three_judgments.path: PARTIAL/WEAK. Real conversion (rev +2.5x YoY $11.3M->$28.5M, SiCore 97% of product rev) but discriminators mostly GUIDED not PRINTED: GM moved WRONG way QoQ (24% Q4'25 -> 20% Q1'26), 25% target is back-half-loaded; firm AMPX-level backlog is THIN/piecemeal ($21M SiCore PO + $18.1M DIU) — the headline '$500M defense awards' are CUSTOMER FFP contracts (AVAV $117M, Kraus Hamdani $270M) that PULL SiCore but at mgmt's stated 5-15% battery BOM = only ~$25-75M potential AMPX content spread over multiple yrs (visibility, not AMPX backlog). >=$130M FY26 guide rests on a steep, un-itemized H2 ramp dependent on Korea/US CM capacity. MAGNITUDE FAILS: from ~$2.84B cap a 4x = ~$11.4B (~88x FY26 sales); even Clear Street's bull (rev ->$530M by 2029) at a generous 8-12x P/S = ~1.5-2x, and its $33 PT is only ~1.7x. The ~7-8x off $2.61 has CONSUMED the venture return — remaining upside is a richer entry price, not an open-ended >=4x. SHOWS conversion; ASSERTS the >=4x.
three_judgments.asymmetry: WEAK. Bull ~1.7-2.5x ($33-50) on flawless H2 + continued re-rate / base ~flat-to-modest ($18-22; consensus PT $22, near fair) / bear -40% to -60% on a missed back-half ramp, GM disappointment, or P/S compression from 28x toward peers ~19x / fair ~7x. Up/down ratio does NOT clearly dominate — fully-recognized marquee name, 9 sell-side 'Strong Buy', 28x P/S near 52-wk high. Asymmetry that existed at discovery (theme map bull-shape assumed sub-$1B cap) has largely closed at ~$2.84B.
three_judgments.survival: ADEQUATE — NOT ruin. Cash $62.4M (Mar-31-26); Q1 op burn $37.3M was inflated by one-time $20M Colorado lease termination + $11.5M AR build (normalizes) -> underlying ~$17M/qtr; CapEx guided <$10M funded by DIU; adj-EBITDA guided positive (>=$4M); warrant exchange REMOVED ~$70M dilution overhang. Runway thin-ish (~3-4 qtrs at elevated rate, extends as burn normalizes/EBITDA turns) — the pin-down's '<1yr-FCF-trend runway watch' is real but no going-concern, no debt wall, no death-spiral. Pre-profit is not impairment (not penalized).

strongest_bear: AMPX is the textbook winner that has ALREADY won: a ~7-8x run from $2.61 to ~$20 pulled the entire >=4x venture return forward into a now-$2.84B cap at 28x sales (vs ~7x fair, ~19x peers), blessed by 9 'Strong Buy' analysts near its 52-wk high. The remaining thesis is execution-on-a-priced-anchor — a steep H2 ramp the firm itself won't quarterly-guide, GM moving the WRONG way QoQ, and the headline '$500M' being customer-BOM visibility not AMPX backlog. From here it is a richer entry price, not an open-ended shot.
drop_reason: thin-setup-not-worth-a-slot — survives the §4/§9 hard kills (real converting business, survival adequate, no disqualifier) but is merely-marginal: the >=4x venture path has been CONSUMED by the ~7-8x run (4x now needs ~$11.4B/~88x sales; even the 2029 bull = ~1.5-2x), so it clears neither a credible >=4x multibagger NOR a PROTECTED 3-4x great trade (downside unprotected at 28x P/S near highs, GM declining QoQ); asymmetry weak. Exactly the 'AMPX priced/late' recognition-closing drop the theme map foreshadowed — theme stays live for a better-priced second-tier vehicle. (NOT a valuation-trap/profitability-gate drop per §7 — the kill is return GEOMETRY × cap, plus weak asymmetry.)
